plan.baseline: Random is uniform over two legal moves. Damage-greedy maximizes immediate expected damage under the declared public set: both moves are equal-power, so its frozen tie-break favors higher priority (Quick Attack). Frozen-initial uses the unchanged binary actor at update zero of the same training seed.
plan.diagnostics: All checkpoints versus random, damage-greedy and the seed's frozen initial policy; nominal 95% pair-bootstrap intervals. Per-seed critic MSE, clipped Brier, out-of-range rate and ten reliability bins are descriptive only.
plan.final_evaluation: All 128 final teams remain reserved; no final episodes read or generated.
plan.pairing: Both seats share the pair's Showdown seed; candidate checkpoints share pair IDs, seed and policy random-key addresses. Diverging paths do not imply identical chance events. One pair is the resampling unit; training seeds are reported separately.
plan.primary: For each of the three training seeds, the fixed final checkpoint's score versus random must be >=0.60, its Bonferroni-adjusted pair-bootstrap lower bound >0.55, and the adjusted paired improvement lower bound over that seed's initialization >0. No seed pooling or checkpoint selection.
plan.scope: Development evaluation of the unchanged public fixed-duel learner in real pinned Showdown; no full G2/G3 or strategic-strength promotion.
plan.stopping: Fixed 2048 updates per seed and all 27 evaluation cells; no early stopping, tuning, selective reruns or final data. Any implementation failure is retained and invalidates that run; a repair requires a new run directory and admission.

plan.checkpoint: Reuse the sealed showdown-chance-checkpoint-1 format and unchanged learner plan. Compare original versus restored next learner and metrics; persist exact fingerprints for later verification.
plan.memory: Process peak/current RSS telemetry; no certified device-memory or system headroom claim.
plan.timing: Continuous monotonic elapsed time after compile/warmup. Includes synchronized cycle validation, bounded aggregation, telemetry and periodic replay audits; excludes the final replay. Cross-check wall-clock deltas to detect suspension when monotonic time pauses. Any host-loop gap or wall/monotonic discrepancy above 30 seconds fails. Final replay is also gap-checked. Audit cycles are excluded from primary counters.

contract.actor: binary-policy-1, unchanged observation-only actor and PPO logs
contract.critical: randomChance(1,24): w < 178956971; conditional mass 178956971/4294967296 under uniform words
contract.law: For a uint32 word w, Showdown random(n)=floor(w*n/2^32). Supported n are 24,16,2. Products are exactly representable in upstream JS Number for these n.
contract.scope: Exact finite-word mappings and 10000 fresh independently seeded fixed-public-duel player-view battles; no hidden-set or full-format certification and no strength claim
contract.streams: Threefry master folded with SDW1 (0x53445731), then game ID, turn, role 0/1 crit by actor, 2/3 roll by actor, 4 tie. Same raw words imply same mapping. No claim of sodium PRNG, raw-seed, consumed-word schedule, or whole-trajectory RNG equivalence.
contract.tie: For ordered seats [first,1-first], shuffle chooses index w>>31, hence first seat is first XOR (w>>31). Internal sampler uses canonical order [0,1]; captured upstream ordering must be retained.
contract.two_hour_qualification: still required for the new policy/chance combination; not run here

word_audit.scope: all bucket boundary neighbors for n=24,16,2, plus deterministic uniform-word probes through the actual pinned upstream PRNG API

contract.compatibility: No old trajectory/old_logp/checkpoint reuse. New checkpoint format and source/contract binding. Existing simulator chance sampler remains nominal 1/24 and is not Showdown finite-word equivalent.
contract.gradient: Standard FP32 autodiff through clipped sigmoid and log/log1p. Floor is constant with zero derivative at and below floor; at equal logits use the d>=0 branch. No straight-through integer quantizer. The integer sampler is outside the loss gradient.
contract.law: For two legal actions: d = logit0-logit1; rare_action = 1 if d>=0 else 0; r = max(2^-24, sigmoid(-abs(d))) in FP32. Exact masses are r and the real complement 1-r. At equal logits action1 is designated rare but both masses are 1/2.
contract.limits: A short numerical qualification, not a new two-hour soak, strength evaluation, hidden-set coverage or expanded mechanics gate. Final reserved teams stay untouched. Prime unnecessary.
contract.logs: rare log(r), common log1p(-r), FP32; illegal/terminal finite sentinel zero. Returned probabilities are FP32 renderings, not the authority for complements.
contract.mask: One legal action has mass one, logp zero, entropy and policy gradient zero. No legal actions means terminal padding: action -1, probabilities/logs/value zero.
contract.sampling: Fold each supplied Threefry key with 0x44594231; draw two uint32 words in high/low order; choose rare iff concatenated word < r*2^64. Compute the integer threshold from FP32 exponent/mantissa; no FP64 or uniform float is used. Exact mass claims are conditional on uniformly distributed word pairs.
contract.scope: two-action public fixed-duel policy only; full G2/G3 open
